verdict.reason: The hypothesis correctly names an undeserializable poison pill on partition 1. However, it recommends resetting to latest, which is a listed wrong story, so root_cause_correct is false. Its layer placements (order-sync consumer failing, bad record in the Kafka topic) match the ground truth.
